<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The gallery hero (model gallery@1): the heading, a description, up to two links as the actions and three or
  four photos as a list. Axes: media (end: the photos after the copy, start: before it from md up, bottom: in a
  row under it), count (3: three square photos in a row, 4: a 2 x 2 grid, a row of four under the copy).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { GalleryPhoto } from "./gallery-hero.types";

export type GalleryHeroProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  secondaryActionLabel?: string;
  secondaryActionHref?: string;
  photos: GalleryPhoto[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  media?: "end" | "start" | "bottom";
  count?: "3" | "4";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  secondaryActionLabel = "",
  secondaryActionHref = "",
  photos,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "start",
  media = "end",
  count = "3",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<GalleryHeroProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "bottom" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-12"
  : "grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-12 md:grid-cols-2"
);
const photoCols = computed(() =>
  ((media as string) === "bottom") && ((count as string) === "4") ? "grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4"
  : (count as string) === "4" ? "grid-cols-2"
  : "grid-cols-3"
);
const photoOrder = computed(() => ((media as string) === "start") ? "md:order-first" : "");
const photoRatio = computed(() =>
  (media as string) === "bottom" ? "4/3"
  : (count as string) === "4" ? "4/3"
  : "1/1"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="gallery-hero"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="frame">
        <Stack gap="6" :align="column">
          <Title :as="level" size="4xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="lg" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
          <Group
            v-if="((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))"
            gap="4"
            align="center"
            :justify="column"
            class="flex-wrap"
          >
            <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
              {{ actionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
            <LinkButton
              v-if="(secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)"
              variant="secondary"
              size="lg"
              :href="urlOf(secondaryActionHref)"
            >
              {{ secondaryActionLabel }}
            </LinkButton>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid items-start gap-4', photoCols, photoOrder))">
          <ListItem v-for="p in photos" :key="p.id" data-slot="photo">
            <MediaFrame :alt="p.imageAlt" :src="p.image" :ratio="photoRatio" />
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
